claims.text: Draft a one-change plan under LW-6.2. Include a measure, a provisional threshold and a reason the result may be inconclusive. teaching.canDo: Write a single-change learning plan with a prediction, measure and attribution limits.
teaching.keyIdea: Several changes or audience shocks make attribution uncertain.

explanation.text: The agency wants a plan that can teach the creator something. Rule LW-6.2 asks for one change, its expected effect, a measure and the observed result. In the case, the recovery included several changes, so it cannot identify which one mattered. A later raid also changes audience composition. A next-stream experiment can add a poll to a comparable slow segment while holding its goal and duration steady. Record chat rate and segment retention, log raids and audience differences, and choose a provisional review threshold beforehand. A better result is evidence to examine, not proof that the poll caused it.

teaching.selfExplainPrompt: Pitch cause hypothesis, one change, measure and uncertainty to the manager in two lines.

options: New game, time, title and poll together
Promise a fixed increase before testing
Copy the peak without logging changes
One poll change with a prediction and measure
checks.answer: One poll change with a prediction and measure

distractorRationale.New game, time, title and poll together: error: Changes several factors and loses attribution
distractorRationale.Copy the peak without logging changes: error: Selects a peak without a documented intervention
distractorRationale.Promise a fixed increase before testing: error: Promises an effect before collecting evidence

checks.explanation: The rule asks for a traceable single change; several simultaneous changes make attribution harder.

checks.prompt: Why can the case recovery not identify the effect of polls alone?
options: There were no viewer counts
The stream had no chat
Talking and segment context also changed
Every poll must reduce engagement
checks.answer: Talking and segment context also changed

distractorRationale.There were no viewer counts: error: Ignores the available viewer series
distractorRationale.The stream had no chat: error: Ignores the case chat trace
distractorRationale.Every poll must reduce engagement: error: Invents a universal negative poll effect

checks.explanation: Several things changed together, so the historical comparison does not isolate a poll effect.

checks.prompt: What should happen when a raid makes the comparison unclear?
options: Count the whole gain as the poll effect
Log the confounder and qualify the result
Declare the agency rule invalid
Delete the unsuccessful observation
checks.answer: Log the confounder and qualify the result

distractorRationale.Count the whole gain as the poll effect: error: Attributes the raid-driven gain to the poll
distractorRationale.Delete the unsuccessful observation: error: Deletes evidence that complicates the story
distractorRationale.Declare the agency rule invalid: error: Treats an inconclusive episode as a rule refutation

checks.explanation: The raid changes who is present; honest review retains the observation and qualifies attribution.

checks.prompt: When should the prediction and review measure be written?
options: Only if the stream improves
Before the planned experiment
Only after seeing the final peak
After choosing the best-looking segment

distractorRationale.Only after seeing the final peak: error: Chooses the measure after observing the outcome
distractorRationale.After choosing the best-looking segment: error: Selects the most favourable segment after the fact

checks.explanation: Writing the measure beforehand reduces hindsight selection and makes the later review auditable.

checks.prompt: What does meeting the provisional threshold establish?
options: Evidence to review with context
A guaranteed repeatable audience gain
Proof the poll caused the result
Permission to omit the VOD review

distractorRationale.Proof the poll caused the result: error: Equates a threshold crossing with causal proof
distractorRationale.A guaranteed repeatable audience gain: error: Confuses one episode with a guaranteed repeatable gain
distractorRationale.Permission to omit the VOD review: error: Omits contextual review after a favourable metric

checks.explanation: A threshold organises review. Context and confounders still matter, especially with one illustrative episode.
